name: Tax on a full AHV pension in Zurich
workings: A retiree pays no BVG or 3a contributions, so the insurance deductions are the amounts without: federal 2,700, Zurich 4,350 (verify).
Simple tax 744.5000; cantonal 95% = 707.2750; communal (Zurich, 119%) = 885.9550; personal tax 24.
No AHV contributions: past the reference age.
